cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：小心的
cards.example_en: Please be careful when you cross the road.

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: My friend shared her umbrella with me in the rain.
cards.example_zh: 下雨时，朋友和我合撑一把伞。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：友好的
cards.example_en: A friendly librarian showed me where the atlases are kept.
cards.example_zh: 一位友好的图书管理员告诉我地图册放在哪里。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：开心的；快乐的
cards.example_en: Happy shouts came from the playground as soon as the bell rang.
cards.example_zh: 铃声一响，操场上就传来开心的喊声。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：有帮助的
cards.example_en: Our neighbour was helpful when Mum hurt her ankle.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈扭伤脚踝时，邻居帮了大忙。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：羞愧的
cards.example_en: He felt ashamed after copying answers during the quiz.
cards.example_zh: 他在测验中抄了答案，事后感到羞愧。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：煮熟的
cards.example_en: Boiled potatoes and carrots were all we had for dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭我们只有煮土豆和胡萝卜。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：尴尬的
cards.example_en: She felt embarrassed when her phone rang in the quiet library.
cards.example_zh: 她的手机在安静的图书馆里响了，她觉得很尴尬。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：兴奋的
cards.example_en: The pupils were excited about visiting the zoo on Thursday.
cards.example_zh: 学生们对周四去动物园感到兴奋。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：受惊吓的
cards.example_en: The child was frightened by the loud noise.
cards.example_zh: 孩子被大声的吵闹声吓坏了。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：害怕的
cards.example_en: The little boy was scared of the barking dog.
cards.example_zh: 小男孩害怕那只汪汪叫的狗。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：惊讶的
cards.example_en: I was surprised when my drawing won first prize.
cards.example_zh: 我的画得了一等奖，我感到很惊讶。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：担心的
cards.example_en: Mom looked worried when my brother came home late.
cards.example_zh: 弟弟很晚才回家，妈妈看起来很担心。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：烦人的
cards.example_en: That annoying drip from the tap kept me up all night.
cards.example_zh: 水龙头恼人的滴水声让我整夜没睡着。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：令人兴奋的
cards.example_en: The football match was really exciting.
